title: Anyone here know Aippy?
author: Unfair_Ad_2157
selftext:
Have you heard of Aippy? I stumbled upon it thanks to an Instagram ad. It is a platform where you can upload your own vibe coding games and play other people's games, swiping through them like doomscrolling through minigames. I will admit, it is full of trash, yet I am having a lot of fun with it and uploading my own trash too! For anyone who wants to take a look, here are my games, all made with Gemini without any external graphics and all written in React + TypeScript, which is the language used by the Aippy app.

My page in Aippy: [https://aippy.ai/@Huldrafolk](https://aippy.ai/@Huldrafolk)

Let me know if you like my little games. Personally, I think they are very well made and I put some real effort into them, at least to bring a bit of quality to that chaotic sea of memes and brainrot.
